entities.name: Sparrow Hawk
entities.description: Human from North Aerona, younger brother of Gull and Greensleeves, captured and enchanted by Towser into a Keldon warlord.

entities.name: Gull
entities.description: Brother of Sparrow Hawk and Greensleeves who helped lead the army against the wizards.

entities.name: Greensleeves
entities.description: Planeswalker sister of Gull and Sparrow Hawk, later High Wizard of the Domains; she sacrificed her planeswalker powers to cure Lat-Nam.

entities.name: Towser
entities.description: Wizard who captured Sparrow Hawk, enchanted him into a warlord and corrupted his mind.

entities.name: Karli
entities.description: Wizard who with Towser led ten wizards.

entities.name: Haakon
entities.description: Wizard who unleashed a fireball against Gull and Sparrow Hawk.

entities.name: Kwam
entities.description: Lover of Greensleeves who brought her to her senses.

entities.name: North Aerona
entities.description: Region of Dominaria that was home to the siblings.

entities.name: White Ridge
entities.description: Village on the border of the Whispering Woods destroyed during a wizard's duel.

entities.name: Keld
entities.description: Place where Towser sent Sparrow Hawk to be trained.

entities.name: Isle of Lat-Nam
entities.description: Island poisoned and desert, transformed into a verdant forest by Greensleeves.

entities.name: Battle of Lat-Nam
entities.description: Battle after which Greensleeves was declared High Wizard of the Domains.

entities.name: Dominaria
entities.description: Plane where these events take place.

events.summary: White Ridge is destroyed during a wizard's duel and Sparrow Hawk is separated from his family.
events.quote: Sparrow Hawk was separated from his family during the destruction of White Ridge

events.summary: Towser captures Sparrow Hawk, has him trained in Keld and enchants him into a warlord with a corrupted mind.
events.quote: The wizard corrupted his mind, turning him against his family.

events.summary: Gull and Greensleeves form an army and liberate almost all of North Aerona.
events.quote: liberated almost all of North Aerona from rampaging wizards

events.summary: The wizards, aided by the Keldon Warlord, attack the army; Gull is almost killed before Greensleeves teleports him away.
events.quote: Gull confronted the warlord and was almost killed before Greensleeves could teleport him away.

events.summary: Gull dreams of his dead family and realizes the warlord's identity.
events.quote: he had a revelation of the warlord's identity

events.summary: Gull reveals the Keldon is Sparrow Hawk and the brothers reconcile.
Haakon's fireball drives Greensleeves mad with grief and she becomes a godlike being.
events.quote: She became a godlike being and lost herself

events.summary: Kwam brings Greensleeves to her senses; she pours her mana into Lat-Nam, curing it and sacrificing her planeswalker powers.
events.quote: in the process sacrificing her planeswalker powers

events.summary: Greensleeves is declared High Wizard of the Domains; she and her brothers then vanish from history.
events.quote: Greensleeves was declared High Wizard of the Domains by her followers.

relations.quote: He was the younger brother of Gull and Greensleeves
